premises.text: Private tutoring is a standard for success in the Middle East.
premises.evidence_span: Private tutoring is a standard for success.

premises.text: Students struggle to find qualified tutors, taking hours to do so.
premises.evidence_span: One out of three students struggle to find a tutor and it takes, on average, four to five hours to find someone who's qualified, accessible, and available.

premises.text: Synkers connects students to qualified private tutors through a peer-to-peer platform.
premises.evidence_span: Synkers is a peer-to-peer platform that connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps.

premises.text: The platform allows students to select tutors based on preferences and book sessions directly.
premises.evidence_span: pick a course, select a pre-vetted tutor based on your preferences, and directly book a session.

premises.text: The platform includes functionalities for note-sharing, whiteboarding, and video.
premises.evidence_span: we build our online tutoring system from scratch with note-sharing, whiteboarding, and video functionalities.

premises.text: Tutors are rewarded based on the number of hours they teach.
premises.evidence_span: we reward them based on the number of hours they teach.

premises.text: The MENA market for private tutoring is significant, valued at around $1.1 billion.
premises.evidence_span: The MENA market is around $1.1 billion.

premises.text: The global private tutoring market is projected to double in the next four years.
premises.evidence_span: Globally, the private tutoring market is worth $138 billion and is going to double in the next four years.

premises.text: Synkers has a simple business model charging tutors a commission per transaction.
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction.

premises.text: Institutions will be charged for analytics about their students' tutoring activities.
premises.evidence_span: we're also going to charge the institutions, universities, and schools $1,000 per month in exchange for analytics about their students' tutoring activities.

value.text: Education becomes more accessible through a peer-to-peer tutoring platform.
